recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future generated-download scan finds a new active example with an over-length id.
issue_request: FHIR-10281 reported that three Observation genetics JSON examples available from the DSTU2 downloads page had id values longer than the id datatype's 64-character maximum.
initial_application: The Jira resolution and comment state that the examples had already been removed in the STU3 September ballot version. No explicit FHIR-10281-tagged implementation commit was found; the only git grep hit for 10281 was an unrelated imported SVN revision number.
additional_context: Observation is still an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/observation is the relevant current build source. The current source/observation tree contains XML examples only, none of the three reported generated filenames, and no top-level XML/JSON resource id longer than 64 characters. Jira search found only FHIR-10281 for the long-id genetics example terms, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the invalid examples are absent from current active source and the nearby active examples satisfy the id length limit checked for this issue.
